title: Portal Actions
description: Schema for actions.json — portal action definitions consumed by the Server Portal Actions module

sourceName.description: Display name for this source group in the Portal UI (e.g. "JARA")

sourceDescription.description: One-line project description shown on the source group card

title.description: Short display heading — card title, run-dialog heading, confirm titles

info.description: Optional long-form details shown in the card's info tooltip

note.description: Optional callout rendered as a note banner in the card's info tooltip

lifecycle.description: service = runs until manually stopped; portal shows a start/stop toggle with probed status

commands.description: One-shot: the run steps. Service: the START steps.

stop_commands.description: Service only: steps run when stopping.

status_command.description: Service only: probe. Exit 0 = running, non-zero = stopped.

title.description: Short step title shown in the run dialog; UI falls back to description

description.description: Always-visible step summary (rendered under the title in the run dialog)

info.description: Optional long-form detail rendered as a hybrid tooltip on the step — use for text too long for the always-visible description

run_on.description: 'host' runs directly on macOS via SSH, 'container' (default) inside the container
